# Karan Homayounfar (KNHNF)

> MSc Data Science student, UWE Bristol. Forecasting GB electricity balancing costs with
> machine learning. Builds data pipelines, ML systems, and web platforms that run in
> production, not just notebooks. BSc Computer Engineering, ranked 1st in graduating class.

This site is the canonical profile and project landing page for Karan Homayounfar (handle:
KNHNF). Open to internships, graduate roles, and research collaborations in data science,
machine learning, and energy markets.

## Projects

- gb-bm-forecasting: forecasting total GB Balancing Mechanism cost per settlement period
  using Elexon BMRS data, LEAR/XGBoost/LSTM models with rolling-window evaluation and
  Diebold-Mariano testing. MSc dissertation project, repository private during assessment.
- reception-system: offline voice assistant for SMEs using Faster Whisper STT and a
  fine-tuned LLaMA/Phi-3 LLM with Google Calendar integration, prototype stage.
- [epc-retrofit-potential-ml](https://github.com/KNHNF/epc-retrofit-potential-ml):
  predicting UK residential retrofit potential from EPC open data under nested
  cross-validation.
- [england-crime-depriviation-analysis](https://github.com/KNHNF/england-crime-depriviation-analysis):
  distributed Spark pipeline linking crime and deprivation across England.
- [whisper-stt-eval](https://github.com/KNHNF/whisper-stt-eval): speech-to-text evaluation
  on LibriSpeech, WER/CER/latency across model sizes, with a Streamlit dashboard.
- [smartquote-assistant](https://github.com/KNHNF/smartquote-assistant): email extraction
  and quote automation using local and cloud LLMs.

## Notes

- UK English throughout. All figures on this site are real, dated, and caveated where
